Setting.label: Resolution
Setting.summary: Choose the minimum resolution for airings to be recorded.

Setting.label: Replace lower resolution items
Setting.summary: Set whether items in your library may be replaced by higher resolution recordings. This will replace any matching items in your library, not just prior DVR recordings.

Setting.label: Allow partial airings
Setting.summary: Choose whether a recording may begin for an airing already in progress.

Setting.label: Minutes before start
Setting.summary: The default duration to record before the scheduled time.

Setting.label: Minutes after end
Setting.summary: The default duration to record after the scheduled time.

Setting.label: Enhanced Guide
Setting.summary: When enabled, richer information is downloaded for some shows and movies. This makes guide refreshing slower.

Setting.label: Postprocessing script
Setting.summary: Path to a program which postprocesses the recording before adding to the library. The script must be in "/var/lib/plexmediaserver/Library/Application Support/Plex Media Server/Scripts"

Setting.label: Detect commercials
Setting.summary: Attempt to automatically detect and remove commercials from recordings. This process may take a long time and cause high CPU usage. 'Detect and delete commercials' will delete detected commercial footage from your video files. 'Detect commercials and mark for skip' will leave the video files intact.
Setting.enumValues: 0:Disabled|1:Detect and delete commercials|2:Detect commercials and mark for skip

Setting.label: Perform refresh of program guide data.
Setting.summary: Start time of guide refresh can be edited below.

Setting.label: Guide Refresh Time
Setting.summary: Guide refresh will start within the above selected time window.

Setting.label: Guide Refresh Interval
Setting.summary: Guide will refresh after this many hours has passed.

Setting.label: Kids Categories
Setting.summary: Comma-separated list of categories considered kids' content.

Setting.label: News Categories
Setting.summary: Comma-separated list of categories considered news.

Setting.label: Sports Categories
Setting.summary: Comma-separated list of categories considered sports.
